name: Sylvia V. Macias
office: South Whittier School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Sylvia V. Macias is a member of the South Whittier School District Governing Board and currently serves as its Clerk, representing Trustee Area 5. She has held a seat on the board since at least 2013.
